intro: The Strawberry Ginger (16 oz) is a refreshing beverage from the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) that combines sweet strawberries with spicy ginger notes. At just 120 calories, this handcrafted drink offers a perfect balance of fruit-forward flavor and warming spice. Made with real strawberries, fresh ginger, cane sugar, and water, it is a naturally energizing option from the [full CAVA menu](/). This drink provides a flavorful alternative to standard sodas.
priceCalories: Priced at $3.45 for a 16 oz serving, the Strawberry Ginger drink contains 120 calories with 30g of carbohydrates, 0g of protein, and 0g of fat. This makes it an affordable and relatively light beverage choice compared to many restaurant drinks. The calorie count is moderate for a sweetened beverage, making it suitable for those monitoring their daily intake while enjoying a flavorful refreshment at CAVA.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this beverage apart is the sophisticated pairing of sweet strawberries with zesty ginger. Unlike typical fruit drinks, the ginger adds a warming, slightly spicy kick that elevates the strawberry sweetness. Made with real fruit and fresh ginger rather than artificial flavors, this drink delivers authentic taste. The simple ingredient list of strawberries, ginger, cane sugar, and water ensures quality without unnecessary additives or preservatives.
nutritionFacts: Each 16 oz serving delivers 120 calories entirely from 30g of carbohydrates, with zero protein and zero fat. The carbohydrates come from natural fruit sugars and added cane sugar. With no artificial sweeteners, colors, or preservatives, this beverage provides a cleaner ingredient profile. For detailed nutrition information across all menu items, visit the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to plan your complete meal.
whatsInside: The Strawberry Ginger drink contains four simple ingredients: strawberries, ginger, cane sugar, and water. Fresh strawberries provide natural fruit sweetness and vibrant flavor, while real ginger root adds a spicy, aromatic kick. Cane sugar balances the tartness and ginger heat, creating a harmonious blend. Water serves as the base, allowing the fruit and spice flavors to shine through without dilution or masking.
tasteLike: This beverage offers a delightful contrast of sweet and spicy flavors. The initial taste is bright and fruity from ripe strawberries, followed by a gentle warming sensation from fresh ginger. The sweetness from cane sugar balances the ginger spice without overpowering it. The finish is refreshing with a subtle lingering ginger tingle. The texture is smooth with natural fruit notes throughout each sip.
customize: The Strawberry Ginger drink comes as a crafted beverage with a set recipe, ensuring consistent flavor in every order. While the drink itself is not customizable, you can pair it strategically with items from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) or [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas). Consider adding extra ice if you prefer a more diluted, lighter sweetness, or enjoy it as served for full flavor intensity.
pairsWell: This refreshing drink pairs exceptionally well with Mediterranean flavors from CAVA. It complements spicy options from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/mains) by providing cooling relief, while the ginger echoes warm spice notes. The fruity sweetness balances savory dishes featuring feta, olives, or tahini-based dressings. It also works well alongside grain bowls or pitas, cutting through rich flavors with its bright, refreshing profile and cleansing the palate between bites.
healthyChoice: At 120 calories with zero fat and zero protein, the Strawberry Ginger drink is a lighter beverage option compared to many restaurant drinks. The 30g of carbohydrates provide quick energy from natural and added sugars. While it contains cane sugar, the drink features real fruit and ginger rather than artificial ingredients. For those watching sugar intake, consider this an occasional treat. Check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for dietary considerations.
howToOrder: Order the Strawberry Ginger (16 oz) directly from the drinks section when building your meal at any [CAVA location](/locations). Simply tell the staff you would like the Strawberry Ginger drink in the 16 oz size. It is available alongside other handcrafted beverages and complements any bowl or pita combination. The drink comes ready to enjoy with your meal, requiring no customization or special preparation.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade (16 oz) at 260 calories, the Strawberry Ginger offers less than half the calories at 120, making it a lighter choice. The Blueberry Lavender (16 oz) contains 140 calories, slightly more than Strawberry Ginger. While lemonade delivers classic citrus tartness, Strawberry Ginger provides unique fruit-and-spice complexity. All three drinks are priced at $3.45 for 16 oz, offering equal value with different flavor profiles.
whoShouldTry: This drink is perfect for adventurous beverage enthusiasts who enjoy unique flavor combinations beyond typical soft drinks. Ginger lovers will appreciate the warming spice balanced with fruity sweetness. Those seeking a moderate-calorie refreshment that is not too heavy will find the 120-calorie profile appealing. It suits anyone looking to explore the diverse [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks) offerings with something distinctive yet accessible and crowd-pleasing.
worthTrying: The Strawberry Ginger (16 oz) is absolutely worth trying for its unique flavor profile and quality ingredients. At $3.45 and 120 calories, it offers excellent value for a handcrafted beverage made with real fruit and fresh ginger. The sweet-spicy balance sets it apart from standard restaurant drinks, providing a memorable taste experience. Whether you are a regular CAVA guest or first-time visitor, this refreshing drink enhances any Mediterranean meal perfectly.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in the Strawberry Ginger drink?
faqs.a: The Strawberry Ginger drink contains four simple ingredients: strawberries, ginger, cane sugar, and water. This straightforward recipe uses real fruit and fresh ginger without artificial flavors, colors, or preservatives for an authentic taste experience.

faqs.q: How much does the Strawberry Ginger 16 oz cost at CAVA?
faqs.a: The Strawberry Ginger drink in 16 oz size is priced at $3.45 at CAVA locations. This price point matches other handcrafted beverages like Classic Lemonade and Blueberry Lavender in the same size, offering consistent value across the drinks menu.

faqs.q: Is the Strawberry Ginger drink gluten-free?
faqs.a: Yes, the Strawberry Ginger drink is gluten-free as it contains only strawberries, ginger, cane sugar, and water. None of these ingredients contain gluten. For comprehensive dietary information, consult the CAVA Allergen Menu to ensure the drink meets your specific needs.

faqs.q: How does Strawberry Ginger compare to other CAVA drinks?
faqs.a: The Strawberry Ginger has 120 calories, fewer than Classic Lemonade at 260 calories and slightly less than Blueberry Lavender at 140 calories for the same 16 oz size. All are priced at $3.45, but Strawberry Ginger offers a unique sweet-spicy flavor profile.
